race.description: Riverina Volkswagen Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: COLORADO SUN (6) near his top for this third up and has the speed to push forward from the draw. Stuck on well with the 59kg when fourth over 1435m at Moruya. Doesn't have to improve much to get off the mark. GOLD DECREE (3) has a good record at this track and trip. Appreciated the firmer surface with a tough on pace second over 1400m at Corowa. Gets the claim today and sure to be thereabouts. ISOTROPIC (8) dropped in grade with a closing third over 1460m at Queanbeyan. Maps well again and has solid each way prospects. SENSESATIONAL STAR (9) comes here deep into the campaign and no shock to see him figure in the minor money.
